2116565961385857101.en_summary: @ylecun agrees that the evil nature of non-linearities that cannot produce zero-mean output distributions has been known for a long time. They create badly conditioned cost functions. Links to NeurIPS 1990 paper and citation.
2116565961385857101.zh_summary: @ylecun同意，無法產生零均值輸出分佈的非線性「邪惡本質」早已為人所知。它們會產生條件不佳的成本函數。附上1990年NeurIPS論文和引用連結。
